chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 384: Ji Ning Faces Two Brutal Trials in the Quya Mountains
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning enters the perilous Quya Mountains, enduring an invisible pressure zone and a devastating lightning barrage. He faces a true Trial by Combat against an ancient formation, meeting a rival and a mysterious voice.
og_description: Ji Ning's first true trial in the Tristar Crescent Continent. Discover the mystery of the Quya Mountains as he battles formless pressure and lethal lightning.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 384: Trial by Lightning
twitter_description: Ji Ning is stuck! An ancient lightning field blocks his path deep in the Quya Mountains. Who is the mysterious voice taunting him?

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning so cautious if the Tristar Crescent Continent is his home turf?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Even in a safe zone, ancient dangers from the Primordial Era can exist. Ji Ning's "deadly serious" reaction to the mountains' aura shows his decades of tempered Dao-heart; he trusts his instincts over his false sense of security.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Golden-Furred Bear King call Ji Ning 'Northmont Immortal'?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Bear King does not know Ji Ning's true identity. He identifies him by his widely known honorific among the demon kings of the Eastern Stream, reflecting his reputation from their previous conflict.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the 'Trial by Combat' trope mentioned in the guide?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A classic Xianxia structure where a location or test strips away the protagonist's external advantages (like flight, divine sense, or special treasures) and forces them to rely on their pure, fundamental cultivation and Dao-comprehension to survive. The Quya Mountains are a perfect example of this.
